reviewedPolicies: FaceBakery computes material transparency from sorted source/default UV extrema before corner rotation or UV lock.

SpriteContents records whole original-image transparency; opaque sheets and full source rectangles return it. Other rectangles floor float lower products and ceil float upper products; animated frames are unioned without interpolation promotion.
NativeImage empty rectangles contain no alpha samples; zero and partial alpha distinguish cutout and translucent.
RenderPipelines terrain cutout uses ALPHA_CUTOUT 0.5F and translucent terrain uses 0.1F, including multidraw variants. Terrain shader discards alpha strictly below the defined threshold.
provenance: Official patch context and complete unofficial source/asset mirrors. No selected archive authentication, native API compilation, runtime or pixel parity established. No reproduced source bodies or shader assets bundled.
implementation: Per-face pre-transform alphaUv metadata; distinct bounded mapped/model/sheet caches in standalone/shared preparation; empty source summaries; shared AlphaClass thresholds in GLSL generation and displayed-raster picking. Fluid groups and generic mapped material scopes retained.
